payload.text: 2026-09-22 afternoon, hv rulings after the 0.1.6 cut. (1) ADD intent/.canon/** beside intent/whiteboard/** fleet-wide, with the justification changed from a hit rate to the MECHANISM -- what no job READS -- because that one sentence had been wrong three independent ways: wrong UNIT (GitHub decides per push, not per commit, so 47% of commits is 13% of pushes), wrong ERA (the window straddled hand-authored boards becoming generated views, so 13% of pushes is 0% in the fortnight before the cut), and wrong ESTATE-TO-ESTATE (13% at devbin, 4% at Utilz, 35% and falling at Laksa). (2) PUBLISH 0.1.6 to the install. (3) "stop dicking around and just fix this... I want this delivered... uniform, coherent" -- so the lint was done rather than deferred, and it found two real defects. (4) "Yes, please fix" on the concurrency audit. (5) On Cdtempl being the only estate not tracking its devbin manifest: "Ok, so fix it, please". ALSO RULED BY hv IN PEER SESSIONS and confirmed to each node there, not relayed as authorisation by vc: the sweep approved in Utilz, Gtools, Intent and Laksa, in hv words "that is approved by me. I got it to lift this repo to the latest version." Every one of the five estate VCs declined to treat vc relay as a push go, which is the protocol working in the direction it was built for.
